Nanu {softi weer}ku {ceelol} daffesneh.

Nagaale! Anu Rayan, MidiyaTek kibneh derret yan dadlise. Anu qibnaytiino kee kobxissoh awqentitte giibik iroh reebisa ta kibne currik tanim kee fakut tan. Koo catte koo tekkek, ku maganak qokol abtam cubbit hayta — kulli numuh cugayso manol dacrissa.

Nanu {softi weer}ku {ceelol} daffesneh.

Alsi addat 200 dollarih gaba bahta — faxe qokol atu abtaah, tama aalat ciggiila le numuh manoh akah takkennah cato abta.

rockbox_wizard_title: Rook sandug 360p ximmoomaa kee kutbeh xikne
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1.USB akatta irgiqa.
2. Digir abeynit cayla qagitak ugussaay, Rockbox fanah culsaanam faxximta.
3. Rockbox inki adda gexak, USB akatat qagitaak osgoorow, tokkeek Continue xukkuta.
rockbox_wizard_adb_title: 2hayto maaqatta: ADB daga digir abe gorrisaanama...
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: assabalta wagitta ADB angaaraw ( ilaa 30 sekenxi fan). yahaaz geytimek, ximmooma tatrussaah, digir abeynit sissikuk ugtele. akkewaytek, fooca fan USB kobxissoh caalat fan kaqitta.
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: sekenxih addat uli ADB yahaaz mageytiminna; USB kobxissoh caalatat bisoh iyyaanama.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: ADB nammaytakkoh abnisso matan; USB kobxissoh caalatat bisoh iyyaanama.
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: ADB amol ximmoomaa kee kutbeeba gutqo...
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: ADB tabsi radeh; USB kobxiseenah caalat fan wadirih raddaama
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. USB kobxissoh caalat digreyna tonnal kokkobiseh innal yanbulle.
2. FAXE folder gubal yan (.rockbox, Muziik, Themes, hinnay drive root — uqrat tan .rockbox folder isih elle geytima).
3. App 360p themes kee font addat, inki migaq le faylitte lih angaaraw le.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Atu away amaanah garuq digirtam kee ugussam ximmo Rock sandugih addat ( farmooma> ximmo farmooma).
